def slide() do
  column(
    [
      height(fill()),
      width(fill()),
      padding(48),
      spacing(48),
      Background.color(color(:black)),
      Font.color(color(:white)),
      Font.size(48)
    ],
    [
      el([center_x(), center_y()], text("Stateful components, not even once.")),
      el(
        [width(fill()), Font.family("monospace"), Font.size(22)],
        Makeup.highlight("IO.puts(:hello)",
          formatter: Makeup.Formatters.Emerge,
          formatter_options: [style: :monokai_style]
        )
      )
    ]
  )
end
